is_mandatory.quote: After January 1, 2018, only persons licensed as respiratory care and polysomnography practitioners or as polysomnographic technologists pursuant to this chapter, or excepted from the requirements of this chapter may perform sleep-related services.

title_protection.quote: A person who is licensed to engage in the practice of polysomnography shall have the right to use the title "polysomnographic technologist" or the letters "P.S.G.T." after the person's name. No other person may use that title or letters or any other words or letters indicating that the person is a polysomnographic technologist.

definition_quote.value: The practice of polysomnography consists of but is not limited to the following tasks as performed for the purpose of polysomnography, under the general supervision of a licensed physician or qualified health care professional prescriber
definition_quote.quote: The practice of polysomnography consists of but is not limited to the following tasks as performed for the purpose of polysomnography, under the general supervision of a licensed physician or qualified health care professional prescriber

value: Monitoring, recording, and evaluating physiologic data during polysomnographic testing
Noninvasive continuous, bilevel positive airway pressure, or adaptive servo-ventilation titration
Supplemental low-flow oxygen therapy of less than six liters per minute
Sleep stage recording using surface EEG, EOG, and surface submental EMG
Use of oral appliance as directed by a licensed dentist
methods_authorized.quote: Monitoring, recording, and evaluating physiologic data during polysomnographic testing and review during the evaluation of sleep-related disorders, including sleep-related respiratory disturbances, by applying any of the following techniques, equipment, or procedures

credential_body.quote: Obtaining the registered polysomnographic technologist credential from the board of registered polysomnographic technologists.

value: Graduation from a polysomnographic educational program accredited by the Committee on Accreditation for Polysomnographic Technologist Education (CoA-PST)

Graduation from a respiratory care educational program accredited by CoARC or CAAHEP, plus polysomnographic certificate, sleep disorder specialist credential, RPSGT credential, or other board-approved credential

Graduation from an electroneurodiagnostic technologist educational program accredited by the Committee on Accreditation for Education in Electroneurodiagnostic Technology or CAAHEP, plus polysomnographic certificate
approved_education_pathways.quote: Graduation from a polysomnographic educational program that is accredited by the committee on accreditation for polysomnographic technologist education or an equivalent program as determined by the board.

grandfathering_provision.quote: a person who is working in the field of sleep medicine on January 1, 2017, may apply to the board for a license to perform polysomnography. The board shall issue a license to the person, without examination, provided the application contains verification that the person has completed five hundred hours of paid clinical or nonclinical polysomnographic work experience within the three years prior to submission of the application.

value: Direct supervision: the respiratory care and polysomnography practitioner or polysomnographic technologist must be present where the polysomnographic procedure is being performed and immediately available to furnish assistance and direction throughout the performance of the procedure.

General supervision: the polysomnographic procedure is provided under a physician's or qualified health care professional prescriber's overall direction and control, but the physician's or qualified health care professional prescriber's presence is not required during the performance of the procedure.
supervision_level_definitions.quote: "Direct supervision" means that the respiratory care and polysomnography practitioner or the polysomnographic technologist providing supervision must be present where the polysomnographic procedure is being performed and immediately available to furnish assistance and direction throughout the performance of the procedure.

supervising_physician_specialty_required.quote: "Physician" means a person who is currently licensed in Iowa to practice medicine and surgery or osteopathic medicine and surgery and who is board certified and who is actively involved in the sleep medicine center or laboratory.

value: Physician assistant operating under the prescribing authority granted in section 147.107
Advanced registered nurse practitioner operating under the prescribing authority granted in section 147.107
qualified_prescriber_types.quote: "Qualified health care professional prescriber" means a physician assistant operating under the prescribing authority granted in section 147.107 or an advanced registered nurse practitioner operating under the prescribing authority granted in section 147.107.

value: A facility accredited by a nationally recognized sleep medicine laboratory or center accrediting agency
A facility operated by a hospital or a hospital licensed under chapter 135B
A patient's home pursuant to rules adopted by the board
practice_setting_restrictions.quote: The practice of polysomnography shall take place only in a facility that is accredited by a nationally recognized sleep medicine laboratory or center accrediting agency, in a facility operated by a hospital or a hospital licensed under chapter 135B, or in a patient's home pursuant to rules adopted by the board

scoring_and_education_setting_exception.quote: provided, however, that the scoring of data and the education of patients may take place in another setting.

oral_appliance_dentist_requirement.quote: Use of any oral appliance used to treat sleep-disordered breathing while under the care of a licensed polysomnographic technologist during the performance of a sleep study, as directed by a licensed dentist.

oxygen_flow_limit_liters_per_minute.quote: Supplemental low-flow oxygen therapy of less than six liters per minute, utilizing a nasal cannula or incorporated into a positive airway pressure device during a polysomnogram.

authorized_pap_modalities.quote: Noninvasive continuous, bilevel positive airway pressure, or adaptive servo-ventilation titration on spontaneously breathing patients using a mask or oral appliance

airway_device_tracheal_restriction.quote: provided, that the mask or oral appliance does not extend into the trachea or attach to an artificial airway.

patient_population_restriction.quote: for the purpose of assisting a physician in the diagnosis and treatment of sleep and wake disorders that result from developmental defects, the aging process, physical injury, disease, or actual or anticipated somatic dysfunction.

value: Polysomnographic student: enrolled in a board-approved program; may provide sleep-related services under direct supervision as part of educational program

Polysomnographic technician: graduated from a board-approved program but has not yet received an accepted national credential; may practice under direct supervision for up to thirty days following graduation while awaiting credentialing examination scheduling and results
tiered_credential_levels.quote: "Polysomnographic technician" means a person who has graduated from a program approved by the board, but has not yet received an accepted national credential awarded from an examination program approved by the board and who may provide sleep-related services under the direct supervision of a licensed respiratory care and polysomnography practitioner or a licensed polysomnographic technologist for a period of up to thirty days following graduation while awaiting credentialing examination scheduling and results.

technician_temporary_permit_duration_mon.quote: who may provide sleep-related services under the direct supervision of a licensed respiratory care and polysomnography practitioner or a licensed polysomnographic technologist for a period of up to thirty days following graduation while awaiting credentialing examination scheduling and results.
